stem: In the Middle Ages, Europeans placed the holy city of Jerusalem at the center of maps, reflecting the prevailing ____ of the era.

items.answerReviewReason: 校对认为配套答案不可靠
items.explanation: 配套答案为 C（anthropocentrism，人类中心主义）。把圣城耶路撒冷放在地图中心，反映的是当时以宗教为核心的世界观，与“以人为中心”无关，更合理的是 D（cosmology）。

stem: Their remote jungle habitat and their extreme shyness have (i)____ any thorough investigation of orangutans except in the (ii)____ conditions of captivity.

Some of the reasons are obvious: although he dressed with conspicuous cool, he chose an artistic trajectory that seemed calculated to (ii)____ the spotlight-his best work was in the bands of other musicians, such as Billie Holiday and Count Basie, rather than at the front of his own. Moreover, he was shy, subtle, and sensitive- traits not usually associated with great (ii)____.
